repo.description:
### Impact

A malicious user was able to create their own table and then move a column to a victims table.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Tables app is upgraded to 0.8.6 or 0.9.3

### Workarounds

* Disable app Tables

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3137895)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/tables/pull/1810)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Missing ownership check in Tables app allows moving columns into tables of other users
